points.point: R&S VNA 的每條規格必須標示型號與文件版次，且數字要連測試條件一起抄，不可自行補齊原文沒有的 option code 或料號
points.label: partial
points.why: says cite R&S facts and preserve conditions, but does not explicitly require model plus document version for every R&S spec or warn not to fill missing option codes/part numbers

points.point: 比較時必須區分 specification / typical / nominal / measured 等級，因為來源明示 R&S 不保證 non-traceable specifications、typical、nominal、measured 值
points.label: covered
points.why: explicitly distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable data and notes they are not guaranteed

points.point: 性能數字（如 dynamic range）必須附上量測條件，例如 measurement bandwidth 與是否套用 user correction
points.label: partial
points.why: requires stated test conditions and mentions measurement bandwidth, but does not specifically require whether user correction was applied

points.point: Vault 對競品 VNA（Keysight PNA）的唯一來源未列型號、頻率範圍、option code 或校準件，且未提供任何性能指標，不足以支撐規格對比
points.label: covered
points.why: states Keysight ENA/PNA evidence lacks model, frequency range, option codes, calibration kit, and performance metrics

points.point: R&S 內部 battle card 對競品的描述屬單一來源，用於客戶文件前需以競品官方資料或第三方資料驗證
points.label: partial
points.why: requires direct competitor documentation, but does not specifically address internal battle-card claims as single-source material needing official or third-party verification

points.point: only platform、leadership、lower TCO 等 sales language 不可當作可驗證技術規格，且 TCO 主張沒有算式或實證資料
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention only platform, leadership, lower TCO, sales language, or lack of TCO calculation/evidence

points.point: 半導體相關的 ZNA / ZNA67EXT 對應只來自 Excel solution mapping，該欄不是正式 datasheet / application note / configuration guide，不得據此報價或建立測試配置，也未提供 option / fixture / calibration 條件
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention the Excel semiconductor ZNA/ZNA67EXT solution mapping, its non-formal status, or limits on quotation/configuration use

points.point: 半導體客戶與 R&S solution 同列不代表已購買、評估、合作或導入，不能作為客戶實證
points.label: missing
points.why: does not warn that semiconductor customer names listed with R&S solutions are not proof of purchase, evaluation, cooperation, or deployment
